title: feat(graph): local graph view with hop slider
message:
Add bfsNeighborhood (lib/graphLocal.ts) for ±N hop filtering from a
focus node and LocalGraphControls UI with 전체/로컬 toggle + hop
range (1-5). RightWriter applies the BFS between its fetched
gNodes/gEdges and the QAGraph, using gSelectedId (with fallback to
focusQaId) as the focus. Controls render both in the inline panel
and the fullscreen modal; node counter shows shown/total.

Client-side BFS chosen over server filter — payload is already
fetched and slider response stays instant.
